summary: The root EDw primarily means to divide or distribute something into parts, like dismembering an animal or distributing an inheritance.
lane: 2 تَعْضِيَةٌ ذ signifies The act of dividing [a thing] into parts, or portions: and the act of distributing: as also [in both of these senses]. (K, TA.) You say, عَضَّيْتُ الشَّاةَ , (S,) or الذَّبِيحَةَ , (Msb,) inf. n. تَعْضِيَةٌ , (S,) I divided the sheep, or goat, (S,) or the slaughtered animal, (Msb,) into أَعْضَآء [i. e. limbs, or members, &c.; I limbed it, or dismembered it ]: (S, Msb:) and الشَّاةَ , aor. يَعْضُوهَا , inf. n. عَضْوٌ , he divided the sheep, or goat, into parts, or portions. (TK.) And عَضَّيْتُ الشَّىْءَ , inf. n. as above, I distributed the thing: (S:) and , aor. يَعْضُوهُ , inf. n. عَضْوٌ , he distributed it. (TA.) It is said in a trad., لَا تَعْضِيَةَ فِى مِيرَاثٍ إِلَّا فِيمَا ٱحْتَمَلَ القَسْمَ [ There shall be no distributing in an inheritance, except in the case of that which is susceptible of division ]; i. e., what is not susceptible of division, such as the bead of precious stone, and the like, shall not be distributed, even though one or more of the inheritors demand its division, because therein would be injury to them or to one or more of them; but it shall be sold, and its price shall be divided among them. (S.)

headwords.def: aor. يَعْضُو, inf. n. عَضْوٌ: see 2, in three places. العَضْوُ in the language of the Arabs signifies [also] السِّحْرُ [i. e. عَضْوٌ is the inf. n. of عَضَا signifying He enchanted; like عَضْهٌ an inf. n. of عَضَهَ: see the last sentence of the first paragraph of art. عضه ].

signifies The act of dividing [a thing] into parts, or portions: and the act of distributing: as also [in both of these senses]. (K, TA.) You say, عَضَّيْتُ الشَّاةَ, (S,) or ال َّبِيحَةَ, (Msb,) inf. n. تَعْضِيَةٌ, (S,) I divided the sheep, or goat, (S,) or the slaughtered animal, (Msb,) into أَعْضَآء [i. e. limbs, or members, &c.; I limbed it, or dismembered it ]: (S, Msb:) and الشَّاةَ, aor. يَعْضُوهَا, inf. n. عَضْوٌ, he divided the sheep, or goat, into parts, or portions.

and عِضْوٌ, (S, Msb, K, &c.,) the former of which is the more commonly known, (Msb, TA,) [ A limb, a member, and an organ, of the body;] any bone with the flesh entire, or with much flesh; (M, TA;) any entire bone of the body; thus in the Abridgment of the 'Eyn; (Msb;) any flesh that is entire, or much in quantity, with its bone: (K, TA;) a [ distinct ] portion of the body; (KL;) a part of an animal, such as the head, (Msb in art.

A piece, part, or portion, (Msb, K,) of a thing: originally عِضْوَةٌ: pl. عِضُونَ, irreg., like سِنُونَ. (Msb.) And A party, sect, or class, (K, TA,) of people: (TA:) [pl. as above:] one says, فِى الدَّارِ عِضُونَ مِنَ النَّاسِ In the house, or place of abode, are [ several ] parties, sects, or classes, of people: (S, TA:) so says As, (S,) or Ks. (TA.) Also A lie, or falsehood: pl. عِضُونَ. (K) In this sense, (TA,) as sing. of the last word in the saying in the Kur [xv.
The state of possessing sufficient clothing and food. (ISd, K.)
applied to a camel, and عَضَوِيَّةٌ applied to camels: see عِضَهِىٌّ in art. عضه.
A man possessing sufficient clothing and food. (ISd, K.) See also 1, last sentence.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
